title: Auger Effect Description
description: Essential Criteria: The response must accurately describe the Auger effect as a nonradiative transition involving the ejection of an electron from a higher energy shell.

title: Anomalous Zeeman Effect
description: Essential Criteria: The response must explain the anomalous Zeeman effect as the splitting of spectral lines in a magnetic field due to electron spin.

title: Lamb Shift Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must define the Lamb shift as the energy difference between specific hydrogen atom states caused by electron interactions.

title: Landé Interval Rule
description: Important Criteria: The response must state the Landé interval rule regarding the energy difference between adjacent J levels in LS coupling.

title: Hund's Rules Overview
description: Important Criteria: The response must summarize Hund's rules for atomic levels, including the conditions for lowest energy configurations.

title: Missing Key Details
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response may lose points for omitting key details or definitions related to the effects or rules described.

title: Clarity and Conciseness
description: Optional Criteria: The response should be clear and concise, effectively communicating the concepts without unnecessary complexity.

title: Correct Terminology
description: Optional Criteria: The response should use correct scientific terminology throughout to enhance understanding.
